title: DIALECTIC: A Multi-Agent System for Startup Evaluation

live_model.evidence: For the LLM, we use OpenAI's gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 (OpenAI, 2025). We set the temperature parameter to 0.0 for the answer agent and to 0.5 for all other agents (Section 3.4)

prompt.location: Appendix C, Listings 1-10 (decomposer, answer agent, generator, critic, evaluator, refiner, IO baseline)

claim.metric: AUC-PR on the held-out test set
claim.location: Section 5 text and Figure 3 ('AUC-PR of 0.2422 on the test set'); split of 129/130 startups

data.source: 259 startups from real VCs' 2021 watchlists with Crunchbase and homepage data; not released

notes: Code at github.com/pantageepapa/DIALECTIC; outcome labels derive from proprietary VC data.
